active_authority.historical_plan: AP-001/AP-001_PLAN_FROZEN.md is preserved as historical WP1 authority only

dependencies.required_before_execution: WP1 COMPLETE; D-006 anchor mechanics and development/confirmation partition inherited unchanged

inherits.anchor_rule: D-006 milestone candidate capture: candidate is recorded at the lawful crossing tick, replaced on producer value replacement, and becomes the WEAK/ONLINE anchor at episode arm; STRONG/DECAY_RISK/DYING remain first lawful state entries
inherits.partition: development leaf only; confirmation leaf untouched; cutoff 1773619200000000000 ns
inherits.causal_clock: tick availability = received_ts_ns, tie-break = source_sequence, provenance = event_ts_ns; emitted_events and all completion fields are future outcomes and never anchor-time information

facts: WP1 G3 matched all 24,253 completed development-leaf episodes with zero anchor mismatches under the implemented D-006 mechanics
WP1 recorded one left-truncated track, zero right-censored forming tracks, and zero right-censored armed tracks
WP1 kept the confirmation leaf footer-only and did not use it for development evidence

boundary_and_warm_state.left_boundary: Carry the WP1 LEFT_TRUNCATED_EPISODE flag. Exclude a left-truncated episode only from analyses requiring unseen inception, prior path, or complete dwell; it remains eligible for lawful forward outcomes from an observed in-window state.
boundary_and_warm_state.right_boundary: Retain a still-active episode as RIGHT_CENSORED_EPISODE at the development cutoff. Mark horizons extending past the lawful development window censored/missing; do not impute or call censoring termination.
boundary_and_warm_state.warm_state: Use producer/replay warm state only when its lawful pre-development availability is supplied. WP1 evidence establishes the observed lifecycle boundary facts above but contains no bar/structural warm-state artifact; that demonstrated gap is recorded as missingness for any bridge context requiring unavailable prior state, with no WP1 rerun or invented washout.

objective: Produce the first complete Drift-Burst behavioral result on the development leaf: lifecycle atlas, six native tick-horizon market paths, the separate bounded seven-scale tick-to-bar bridge, internal-attribute splits, and the frozen support/noise reference for later candidate screening.

cohort.anchors: first lawful entry per (armed episode, state) for WEAK, ONLINE, STRONG, DECAY_RISK, DYING, using D-006 candidate capture for WEAK/ONLINE and first lawful state entry for STRONG/DECAY_RISK/DYING
anchor_record: anchor mid = (bid+ask)/2 of the anchor tick; bid/ask recorded

internal state at anchor: operational z/score/efficiency/var_rate/cabs/update_count/duration_s/net_log/direction, authority score_30s/score_60s, multiscale 5s/15s/30s/60s (z, score, efficiency, direction, duration_s, var_rate), milestones crossed so far with ts
episode age at anchor (anchor_ts - origin_ts), state age (anchor_ts - state entry ts)
multiscale agreement: count of agreeing scale directions (5s/15s/30s/60s) and boolean all-agree
left_truncated flag (episode in progress at leaf start)

per_episode: origin (ts, price, direction), arm path (which forming window armed), milestone ladders with latencies from origin
state sequence with entry/exit times, re-entry counts (DECAY_RISK re-entries, DYING re-entries), decay_recoveries
peak: level, points, ts, latency from origin and from each milestone
termination: end_reason, end ts/price, duration origin->end, censor status
burst_points, burst_duration_to_peak_s, completion fields recorded as episode-end facts only
population_tables: occupancy/re-entry table (consecutive state-bearing rows, per WP1 report table for continuity)
dwell distributions per state (tick count and wall seconds; median/quartiles)
termination end_reason distribution by entry state and by direction
censoring: right-censored episodes at cutoff (none expected; dev leaf ends IDLE per WP1), left-truncated count
state persistence: P(next state | current state, first-entry) and conditional on re-entry

market_paths.price: mid = (bid+ask)/2 of ticks; windows measured in availability time from the anchor tick's received_ts_ns
market_paths.horizon_rule: horizon window = ticks with availability in (anchor_avail, anchor_avail + h*1e9]; if the leaf ends or a data gap truncates a window, record missingness with last covered offset; no imputation
measurements_per_window: signed return (raw) and direction-adjusted return (multiplied by anchor direction/internal_sign)
MFE: max favorable excursion (direction-adjusted) and its timing offset ms; MAE: max adverse excursion and timing offset ms
favorable_before_adverse: boolean from first-occurrence timing; adverse_before_favorable: boolean; tie flagged
continuation distance = direction-adjusted MFE magnitude; reversal distance = direction-adjusted MAE magnitude (explicit mapping; both stored)
realized variance: sum of squared per-second bucket log-returns within the window (buckets by floor(avail/1s); empty buckets excluded)
path efficiency: net log return / sum of |per-tick mid log changes| within window; 0 moves -> null
missingness columns per horizon: covered_ns, complete boolean, censor reason
market_paths.normalization: raw values stored; normalized values = return / baseline_IQR(h) of the frozen noise reference; basis recorded alongside

bar_availability_coordinate.provenance: event_ts_ns identifies the source event; bar_close_ts_ns is the native temporal boundary only
bar_availability_coordinate.producer_replay_rule: A completed native bar becomes lawful at the received_ts_ns/source_sequence of the first source tick whose event time enters the next native bucket, using the verified producer/replay availability sidecar coordinate; no nominal bar-close substitution
bar_availability_coordinate.sidecar_reference: crates/research-tape/src/fvg_availability.rs (FVG_BAR_AVAILABILITY_SIDECAR V1); each structural family must bind or explicitly report missing its verified coordinate

native_tick_and_bar_bridge.first_fully_post_anchor_bar: For each native scale, the +1 bar is the earliest bar whose interval start is strictly greater than the anchor event_ts_ns and whose verified availability key (received_ts_ns, source_sequence) is strictly later than the anchor key. Exclude the anchor-containing/partial bar and any pre-anchor price. +2/+3/+5 count from that first fully post-anchor bar.
native_tick_and_bar_bridge.native_clock_separation: The six second-based tick horizons are the primary Drift-Burst clock. The seven-scale bar bridge is a separate bounded outcome layer and never replaces or pools with the native tick outcomes.
native_tick_and_bar_bridge.no_future_conditioning: Later bar or structural events remain outcomes of the tick anchor. A repeated later event may become a separate prospective re-anchor question only at its own verified lawful availability.

ap001_clipping.include_rule: use only sidecar records with available_time_ns < 1773619200000000000
ap001_clipping.outside_exact_ap001_leaf_or_without_veri: explicit UNRESOLVED_AVAILABILITY/missingness; never inferred or forward-filled

availability_order_check.scope: source view and sidecar checks cover the supplied artifacts; AP-001 execution still clips by available_time_ns before the cutoff

sidecar_binding.preflight_requirement: WP2 preflight must record these paths, hashes, source/sidecar counts, cutoff coverage counts, coordinate mapping, and availability_order_check before using any bridge output.
sidecar_binding.scope_limit: This evidence binds availability ordering and coordinate mapping only. It does not prove unavailable bar-detector payload warm state or structural payload semantics; retain the explicit warm-state gap and UNRESOLVED_AVAILABILITY/missingness.

missingness.rule: Retain the anchor in denominators and record explicit per-horizon/per-scale missingness when a lawful payload, availability coordinate, complete bar, or outcome window is unavailable.

internal_attribute_splits.bands: per attribute, quintile edges computed over the development anchor population of the corresponding anchor state; edges frozen into the reference artifact; raw values always retained alongside band labels
categorical_attributes: milestones already crossed (WEAK/ONLINE present at anchor)
session block (per lake analytical_session_authority named windows)
outcomes_conditioned: each horizon's direction-adjusted endpoint return, MFE, MAE, realized variance
internal_attribute_splits.rule: continuous variables stay continuous in evidence; band tables are readable summaries only

support_noise_reference.purpose: frozen before WP3/WP4 outcomes are opened (plan §11); basis for candidate screening and materiality
support_noise_reference.baseline_paths: pseudo-anchors at every 500th development tick (deterministic row index i % 500 == 0 among state-bearing rows), same six horizons, same measurements, no conditioning; stored as the movement baseline
support_noise_reference.materiality_rule: a conditional effect is material when |median direction-adjusted return difference vs the same-horizon baseline median| >= 0.10 * baseline_IQR(h)

low_support_fallback.required_chronological_breadth: at least 3 UTC calendar-month blocks, each with at least 50 effective observations, with the existing block sign/breadth and dominance checks retained

support_rules.effective_observation_unit: one causally eligible analytical unit after conditioning, matching, exclusions, and missingness rules; for matched or paired controls, matched/paired analytical units, never raw rows
support_rules.block_rule: effect sign consistent in >= 3 month blocks, each with >= 50 supporting anchors
support_rules.dominance_rule: no single month contributes > 50% of a cell's support
support_rules.direction_stability: sign of median effect consistent across >= 3 blocks AND across both leaf halves (split at development-leaf midpoint availability time)

determinism.rerun: full scan executed twice; output content hashes must match; measured runtime from the second run
determinism.memory: streaming with bounded pending-window buffer (<= ~301 s of ticks plus pending measurements); report peak RSS
determinism.ordering: sort emitted tables deterministically by native scale, anchor availability key, anchor id, and horizon; serialize canonical JSON before hashing
determinism.reproducibility: record input artifact hashes, contract hash, code identity, run hashes, row/unit counts, missingness counts, and runtime

deliverables.anchors: AP-001/R2_LIFECYCLE_MARKET/AP-001_WP2_ANCHORS.json (or parquet if larger; sha256 recorded either way)
deliverables.preflight: AP-001/R2_LIFECYCLE_MARKET/AP-001_WP2_PREFLIGHT.json (row counts, anchor counts per state vs WP1, determinism hashes, runtime)

exit_condition: Every anchor has a lifecycle result and market-path result, or an explicit INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT/missingness status; atlas and splits complete; determinism hashes match; support reference frozen.
interpretation_boundary: The E1 report is frozen, then interpreted by the research analyst. No scanner change after seeing results (defect protocol excepted). WP2 is discovery only: no candidate promotion, confluence claim, or activation decision; candidates form only after WP4 and director review per the V3 flow.
change_rule: Deviations require decision-log entries and director approval before affected evidence is used.
